result.reasoning_summary: The commit implements exact Approved Model Registry admission for FW-HARNESS-011 workers. The implementation is a pure validation function that accepts an external registry decision via callable, validates all bindings (tenant through Evidence), and denies substitution/expansion/staleness/unapproval. Fallback models are permitted only when separately admitted with matching stable fields and explicit provider/model equivalence enforcement. The patch is narrow (new files only, no existing code modifications), deterministic (pure validation, no side effects), and comprehensive in testing (17 explicit test cases covering substitution, budget expansion, approval denial, staleness, equivalence violation, and resolver failure). No blocking findings detected against stated requirements.
